Definition: a Jebusite or inhabitant of Jebus
BiblicalUsage: The Jebusites were the people of Jebus, listed among the nations of Canaan in the table of peoples. Solomon counted the people left of the Amorites and Hittites and Perizzites and Hivites and Jebusites who were not of Israel, and set them to tribute.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the nations of Canaan were left to test Israel, and the Jebusites held Jerusalem until David's day.
